research_notes: The later policy comparison should use the same workload distributions across P1-P4 where possible.
Otherwise policy effects can be confounded with task-size distribution.
Record per-unit duration estimates and actuals only when the policy uses them.
P1/P2 should not pay prediction overhead they do not need.
P3/P4 must justify their added estimation/adaptation cost through measured utilization or reliability gains.
The simplest near-optimal policy remains the promotion criterion.
